doc.summary: Docstring: drivers/ahci.c -- Polled AHCI (SATA) disk driver.
Docstring: True once ahci_init brought a disk up.
Docstring: HBA version register (major in bits 31:16, minor 15:0).
Docstring: Port number of the claimed disk, or -1 when none.
Docstring: Bitmap of ports the HBA implements (PI register).
Docstring: Human-readable state of the last probe.
Docstring: Capacity of the claimed disk in 512-byte sectors.
Docstring: Probe PCI for an AHCI function and bring up the first ATA disk.
doc.description: Idempotent: a second call returns the cached result. Returns 1 when a disk is ready for I/O, 0 otherwise (ahci_note says why).

name: ahci_read_sectors
signature: int ahci_read_sectors(unsigned lba, unsigned count, void *buf)

doc.summary: Docstring: Read count sectors starting at lba into buf.
doc.description: Any count is accepted; it is split into AHCI_MAX_SECTORS commands. Returns 0 on success, -1 on a bad argument, a range past the disk, a device error or a timeout.

name: ahci_write_sectors
signature: int ahci_write_sectors(unsigned lba, unsigned count, const void *buf)

doc.summary: Docstring: Write count sectors starting at lba from buf, followed by FLUSH CACHE EXT so the data survives a power cut.
Docstring: Publish the disk as "ahci0" in the device registry.
